root_cause.text: The q6apm component's removal callback (which unloads topology and deletes PCM runtimes) executed before its dependent child DAI components were removed, causing those child components to remain linked to the card with dangling pointers, leading to a NULL pointer dereference during subsequent card binding.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "the q6apm-audio .remove callback ... deletes the RTDs that contain the q6apm DAI components before their removal pass runs, leaving those components still linked to the card and causing crashes on the next rebind." The patch adds `remove_order` fields to ensure child components (with `SND_SOC_COMP_ORDER_EARLY`/`FIRST`) are removed before the parent q6apm component (with `SND_SOC_COMP_ORDER_LAST`).
